title: Sidebar
description: Navigation with expandable groups, footer actions and a collapsible sidebar.
docs: Use SidebarLink with render={<NavLink to="/projects" />} to highlight the current page. Add SidebarGroup for nested links and SidebarButton for footer actions. Use SidebarToggle in the sidebar or useSidebar() for a page-toolbar control. Give each sidebar its own SidebarProvider and SidebarNavigation. Collapsing preserves expanded groups and the selected page.
